newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Five missing Israelis found dead in crashed car.
newsitem.headline: Five missing Israelis found dead in crashed car.

text.p: Israeli police on Friday found the car and the bodies of five Israelis who went missing on Thursday in the Jordan Valley area of the West Bank, Israeli security sources said.
"They found the bodies, it was apparently a car accident," one Israeli security source told Reuters.

Israeli and Palestinian forces conducted wide searches on Friday in the Jordan Valley area for the family who had been on their way to their son's wedding, fearing they might have been attacked by guerrillas.

Eli and Claudine Pel left their Jerusalem home in the afternoon on Thursday with their bridegroom son Uri and two of his friends for the wedding near the northern Israeli town of Tiberias. They never arrived. They took the route through the West Bank because it was faster than travelling through Israel.
Israel Radio said the car was found upside down in a wadi off the Jordan Valley road near the Israeli settlement of Argaman north of Jericho in the West Bank.

Israeli forces had searched villages along the route overnight and set up roadblocks. Palestinian forces searched areas under their jurisdiction. A helicopter and two Israeli air force planes joined in the search.
